name: Route
雷達
format:
<canvas id="rc" width="580" height="280" style="background:#001a00;display:block;margin:auto"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
  var cv,ctx,cx,cy,R,pts=[],MAX=200,FADE=3000;
  function setup(){
    cv=document.getElementById('rc');
    if(!cv)return;
    ctx=cv.getContext('2d');
    cx=cv.width/2;cy=cv.height-10;R=cy-10;
  }
  function draw(ang,dist,det){
    if(!ctx){setup();if(!ctx)return;}
    var now=Date.now();
    if(det&&dist<MAX)pts.push({a:ang,d:dist,t:now});
    pts=pts.filter(function(p){return now-p.t<FADE;});
    ctx.fillStyle='#001a00';ctx.fillRect(0,0,cv.width,cv.height);
    ctx.strokeStyle='#003300';ctx.lineWidth=1;
    for(var i=1;i<=4;i++){ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(cx,cy,R*i/4,Math.PI,2*Math.PI);ctx.stroke();}
    for(var a=0;a<=180;a+=30){var r=a*Math.PI/180;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(cx,cy);ctx.lineTo(cx-R*Math.cos(r),cy-R*Math.sin(r));ctx.stroke();}
    var sr=ang*Math.PI/180;
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(0,255,0,0.8)';ctx.lineWidth=2;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(cx,cy);ctx.lineTo(cx-R*Math.cos(sr),cy-R*Math.sin(sr));ctx.stroke();
    pts.forEach(function(p){
      var al=1-(now-p.t)/FADE;
      var dp=p.d/MAX*R;
      var pr=p.a*Math.PI/180;
      ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,255,0,'+al+')';
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(cx-dp*Math.cos(pr),cy-dp*Math.sin(pr),5,0,2*Math.PI);ctx.fill();
    });
  }
  scope.$watch('msg',function(msg){
    if(msg&&msg.payload)draw(msg.payload.angle||90,msg.payload.dist||999,!!msg.payload.detected);
  });
  setup();
})();
</script>
